slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize total monthly profit from the three products, or is there some other objective (e.g., meeting a demand target, minimizing cost)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and whether to maximize profit or use another objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden P0 slot was resolved before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL; no unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained.

summary: The agent asked targeted clarification questions covering the objective and key modeling assumptions, then stopped appropriately after resolving the P0 hidden slot.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
